image.subject: 星宇航空「空山金」準備啟程　A350-1000 B-58554將自土魯斯飛往新家臺北

zh.title: 星宇航空「空山金」準備啟程　A350-1000 B-58554將自土魯斯飛往新家臺北
zh.summary: 星宇航空（STARLUX Airlines）「STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA」藝術塗裝計畫的第二架飛機「空山金」已進入交付階段。根據星宇航空官方 Instagram 公布的最新動態，這架註冊編號 B-58554 的 Airbus A350-1000 正準備自法國土魯斯－布拉尼亞克機場（TLS）啟程，飛往其新家——臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）。
body: 星宇航空（STARLUX Airlines）「STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA」藝術塗裝計畫的第二架飛機「空山金」已進入交付階段。根據星宇航空官方 Instagram 公布的最新動態，這架註冊編號 B-58554 的 Airbus A350-1000 正準備自法國土魯斯－布拉尼亞克機場（TLS）啟程，飛往其新家——臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）。

B-58554 是繼「空山銀」B-58553 後，星宇航空與日本藝術家空山基（Hajime Sorayama）合作打造的第二架 AIRSORAYAMA 特別塗裝機。航空專業媒體 Aviation Wire 報導，B-58554 已於 7 月 10 日在土魯斯完成首次飛行，當次測試飛行約持續 3 小時，並規劃於 8 月交付星宇航空。8 月 12 日，日本航空媒體 TRAICY 亦報導，星宇航空預計在 8 月內正式接收這架飛機。

「空山金」以金屬金色為機身主色，搭配銀色元素，與以銀色為主、金色點綴的 B-58553「空山銀」形成一組相互呼應的設計。兩架飛機的機腹均融入空山基代表性的「機械鯊魚（SORAYAMA Shark）」視覺元素，將其擅長的金屬質感與未來主義美學延伸至大型民航客機。星宇航空表示，由於 A350 採用大量碳纖維複合材料，塗裝除了必須呈現金屬光澤外，也須兼顧航空器防雷擊及相關適航要求，因此星宇航空、Airbus 與德國塗料廠商 Mankiewicz 共同開發高濃度特殊雲母與多層塗佈工法，以完成所需的視覺效果。
B-58554 完成交付後，預計將成為星宇航空機隊中的第 4 架 A350-1000。星宇航空共訂購 18 架 A350-1000，首架 B-58551 已於 2026 年 1 月在土魯斯完成交付，使星宇航空成為臺灣首家營運 A350-1000 的航空公司。A350-1000 也是目前星宇航空長程航線布局的重要主力機型。
「空山金」客艙規劃共 350 個座位，包括頭等艙 4 席、商務艙 40 席、豪華經濟艙 36 席及經濟艙 270 席。隨著 B-58554 完成交付並抵臺，「空山銀」與「空山金」兩架 AIRSORAYAMA A350-1000 將正式到齊；星宇航空規劃自 10 月 1 日起，以兩架藝術機搭配專屬機上用品與服務內容展開完整的 AIRSORAYAMA 主題營運。
目前星宇航空官方最新動態顯示 B-58554 已進入返臺前的最後階段；實際自土魯斯起飛、抵達桃園的時間以及後續正式投入載客營運的安排，仍應以星宇航空公布的航班資訊及實際飛航動態為準。

en.title: STARLUX Airlines' "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Gold" Prepares for Departure: A350-1000 B-58554 Set to Fly from Toulouse to Its New Home in Taipei
en.summary: The second aircraft in STARLUX Airlines' "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA" art livery project, "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Gold," has entered the delivery stage. According to the latest update on STARLUX Airlines' official Instagram, this Airbus A350-1000 registered B-58554 is preparing to depart from Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) in France for its new home at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE).
body: The second aircraft in STARLUX Airlines' "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA" art livery project, "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Gold," has entered the delivery stage. According to the latest update on STARLUX Airlines' official Instagram, this Airbus A350-1000 registered B-58554 is preparing to depart from Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) in France for its new home at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE).

Following "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Silver" (B-58553), B-58554 is the second AIRSORAYAMA special livery aircraft created through a collaboration between STARLUX Airlines and Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama. Aviation trade outlet Aviation Wire reported that B-58554 completed its first flight in Toulouse on July 10, with the test flight lasting approximately three hours, and is scheduled for delivery to STARLUX Airlines in August. On August 12, Japanese aviation outlet TRAICY also reported that STARLUX Airlines expects to officially take delivery of the aircraft within August.

"STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Gold" features metallic gold as its primary fuselage color paired with silver accents, complementing B-58553 "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Silver," which is predominantly silver with gold accents. The belly of both aircraft incorporates Hajime Sorayama's signature "SORAYAMA Shark" visual element, extending his signature metallic textures and futuristic aesthetics onto large commercial passenger jets. STARLUX Airlines stated that because the A350 uses a significant amount of carbon fiber composite materials, the paint finish must achieve a metallic luster while meeting lightning protection and related airworthiness requirements for aircraft. Consequently, STARLUX Airlines, Airbus, and German paint manufacturer Mankiewicz jointly developed a high-concentration special mica and multi-layer coating technique to achieve the desired visual effect.

Upon completion of delivery, B-58554 is expected to become the fourth A350-1000 in the STARLUX Airlines fleet. STARLUX Airlines has ordered a total of 18 A350-1000s, with the first aircraft, B-58551, delivered in Toulouse in January 2026, making STARLUX Airlines the first airline in Taiwan to operate the A350-1000. The A350-1000 also serves as a key backbone aircraft for STARLUX Airlines' current long-haul route network layout.

"STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Gold" features a cabin layout totaling 350 seats, including 4 in First Class, 40 in Business Class, 36 in Premium Economy, and 270 in Economy. With B-58554 completing delivery and arriving in Taiwan, both the "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Silver" and "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Gold" A350-1000s will be officially united. STARLUX Airlines plans to commence full AIRSORAYAMA-themed operations starting October 1 using both art aircraft alongside exclusive inflight amenities and service offerings.

Currently, STARLUX Airlines' official latest updates show that B-58554 has entered the final stage prior to returning to Taiwan; the actual departure time from Toulouse, arrival time in Taoyuan, and subsequent arrangements for entry into revenue passenger service remain subject to flight information and real-time flight status announced by STARLUX Airlines.
